papers.title_en: When do explicit penalties improve flow matching?
papers.authors: Lea Kunkel, Alberto González-Sanz, Sophie Langer
papers.evidence: 惩罚与非惩罚流匹配的理论比较
papers.tldr: 流匹配可直接从数据学习结构，但额外约束惩罚何时真正提升生成仍不清楚。本文以物理信息流匹配为动机，在希尔伯特空间比较惩罚与无惩罚模型的期望平方2-Wasserstein误差，并推导考虑约束违反与投影样本分布的几何准则。对特定速度场类和约束，作者显式求解统计比较，发现惩罚改善精度当估计方差下降超过平方偏差增加。所得公式揭示该权衡随样本量、模型类、噪声调度和惩罚权重变化，为约束生成提供理论依据。
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching can learn structure directly from data, raising the question of when additional constraints improve generation. We study penalties that encode such constraints, with physics-informed flow matching as a motivating example. Satisfying a constraint more closely need not make the generated distribution more accurate. We therefore compare penalised and unpenalised generative modelling through their expected squared $2$-Wasserstein error. Our analysis covers both vector-valued and functional data in a Hilbert-space setting. We first derive geometric criteria that account for constraint violations and the distribution of samples after projection onto the constraint set. We then solve the statistical comparison explicitly for specific velocity-field classes and constraints via flow matching. In this model, penalisation improves accuracy exactly when the reduction in estimation variance outweighs the increase in squared bias. The resulting formula shows how this trade-off depends on sample size, the model class, the noise schedule, and the penalty weight.

papers.authors: Woobin Park, Jaeyeon Kim, Yilun Du, Sitan Chen, Bohyung Han
papers.evidence: 基于扩散与流匹配的一步生成
papers.tldr: 扩散与流匹配生成通常需多次网络评估，一步生成虽受关注却依赖复杂训练机制。Priming Models 采用简单两阶段框架：先以重建目标预训练，再做特征空间分布后训练。作者发现重建阶段已足以消除分布训练的困难，并在多类任务上推进计算-质量前沿。ImageNet 256×256 一步生成取得 FID 1.19，训练计算约为同类方法十分之一。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion and flow matching are now dominant frameworks for generative modeling in continuous domains, but they typically require multiple network evaluations at inference. This has motivated extensive research on one-step generative modeling primarily built on diffusion and flow, though existing approaches often rely on complex training machinery. In this work, we introduce Priming Models, a simple two-stage framework for training one-step generators. Motivated by the difficulty of distributional training from scratch, Priming Models are first trained on a reconstruction objective, e.g., pixel-space denoising at a fixed noise level, before undergoing feature-space distributional post-training. Our central scientific finding is that this simple reconstruction stage is already enough to entirely alleviate the difficulty of distributional training. Empirically, across class-conditional image generation, text-to-image generation, and world modeling, Priming Models significantly advance the Pareto frontier of training compute vs. generation quality. On ImageNet at $256 \times 256$ resolution, we achieve a state-of-the-art FID of $1.19$ among one-step generators using approximately one-tenth the training compute of prior methods with comparable FID. We open-source our codebase at https://github.com/JaeyeonKim01/priming.

papers.title_en: ControlFlow3D: Distilling Multi-View Knowledge into Latent Flow Matching for Point Cloud Upsampling
papers.authors: Yuang Liu, Zhi Zuo, Zhengkai Zhao, Lirui Zhang, Pan Gao, Hao Feng, Zhengzhe Liu
papers.evidence: 在潜在空间用条件流匹配进行三维点云上采样
papers.tldr: 点云上采样受稀疏欠约束观测限制，多视图视觉线索虽能缓解几何歧义却未被充分利用。ControlFlow3D在冻结3D编码器的结构化潜空间做条件流匹配，用soft KMeans联合聚类图像与3D token形成共享原型，并以速度控制和一致性损失蒸馏多视图知识。测试阶段无需多视图输入，Mamba解码器以线性复杂度输出稠密坐标。方法在多个基准上验证有效，并构建规模达35K对象的ShapeNetPU基准，展现强泛化能力。
papers.abstract_en: Point cloud upsampling is essential for 3D applications but remains challenging due to sparse, under-constrained observations. Multi-view images can resolve geometric ambiguity, but existing multi-modal methods do not fully exploit visual cues. We propose ControlFlow3D, a framework that distills knowledge from pretrained foundation models into a lightweight generation network during training, enabling strong performance without multi-view images available at test time. Specifically, our method performs conditional flow matching in a structured latent space defined by a frozen 3D encoder. Multi-view image tokens and 3D latent tokens are jointly clustered into shared prototypes via unsupervised soft KMeans; the resulting prototypes guide the flow trajectory through velocity control and are aligned by a consistency loss that progressively transfers image knowledge into the base network. A Mamba-based geometry decoder then maps latent features to dense coordinates with linear complexity. We also construct ShapeNetPU, a 35K-object multi-modal benchmark that is 31 times larger than prior datasets. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method and its strong generalization capability.

papers.title_en: Destination-Conditioned Adaptation with Semantic-Geometric Alignment for Generative Inbetweening
papers.authors: Zhiyu Xu, Wei Shang, Yushen Xu, Wenwen Li, Zhiyan Xu, Pengfei Zhu, Dongwei Ren
papers.evidence: 改进预训练视频扩散模型以生成时序连贯运动
papers.tldr: 生成式补间需在起止帧间合成时序连贯中间帧，但预训练图生视频扩散模型缺乏显式目标帧约束，大位移和非刚性运动下易漂移。DSG-GI通过目的地条件适配沿生成轨迹提供渐进式目标引导，并用语义-几何对齐约束骨干特征的时空关系与潜在流。实验在标准及大运动补间基准上提升时序稳定性、目标帧忠实度和感知质量，为可控生成式补间提供有效方案。
papers.abstract_en: Generative inbetweening aims to synthesize temporally coherent intermediate frames between a start frame and a target frame. Although pretrained image-to-video diffusion models provide strong priors for large-motion inbetweening, they are not explicitly designed to reach a specified target frame. They may therefore generate realistic individual frames while drifting from the target or producing unstable motion under large displacements and non-rigid dynamics. We propose DSG-GI, a framework that adapts pretrained latent video diffusion models through \textbf{D}estination-Conditioned Adaptation and \textbf{S}emantic-\textbf{G}eometric Alignment. Destination-Conditioned Adaptation treats the target frame as the destination of the sequence and provides temporally progressive guidance along the generated trajectory. Semantic-Geometric Alignment aligns the token-wise spatio-temporal relational geometry of backbone features with that of a frozen video foundation encoder and applies a flow-matching-aware latent flow constraint to samples near the data endpoint of the probability path. Together, these components strengthen destination guidance and preserve coherent semantic-geometric motion structure. Extensive experiments on standard and large-motion inbetweening benchmarks demonstrate improvements in temporal stability, target-frame faithfulness, and perceptual quality. Our code will be made publicly available.

papers.title_en: PotentialEP: Backprop-Free Training of CIFAR-Scale Generative Models via Equilibrium Propagation
papers.evidence: 扩散与流匹配生成模型的无反向传播训练
papers.tldr: 扩散与流匹配生成通常需数百步串行积分，不适合GPU却适合模拟神经形态硬件的一次物理松弛。Energy Matching 可用势能梯度下降松弛采样，但其梯度仍需逐步反向传播。作者证明，在预测编码网络能量中加入单线性注入项后，可见层会自然携带该梯度；据此可无反向传播采样，并可用 Equilibrium Propagation 端到端训练。在 CIFAR-10 上，该法 FID 达 3.64，接近反向传播的 3.54，且仅用卷积与逐点非线性也达 3.51。
papers.abstract_en: Generating an image with a diffusion or flow-matching model typically involves integrating a velocity field for hundreds of sequential steps. That computation suits a GPU poorly and an analog neuromorphic substrate well, where one fast, low-power physical relaxation could replace the whole sequence. Two things are needed: a generative algorithm whose computation is a relaxation, and a way to train it without backpropagation, whose global gradient transport is hard to realise in analog. Energy Matching supplies the first, sampling by gradient-descent relaxation on a time-independent potential - but obtaining the gradient that descent follows is itself a backward pass, once per integration step. We prove that a predictive coding network with a single linear injection term added to its energy relaxes to a state whose visible layer carries that gradient inherently, with an error that vanishes for small injection strengths. An Energy Matching model trained by backpropagation can therefore be loaded into this network unchanged and sampled by relaxation alone, matching the original model's FID to within 0.04 at CIFAR-10 and ImageNet-32 scale. The network can also be trained without backpropagation: Equilibrium Propagation reproduces backpropagation's parameter updates to a cosine similarity of 0.9998, and training end to end with those updates reaches an FID of 3.64 on unconditional CIFAR-10 against 3.54 for backpropagation. To our knowledge this is the first CIFAR-10 generative model trained with Equilibrium Propagation, and the first at competitive quality by any backpropagation-free rule. This quality does not require group normalisation or attention: an architecture of only convolutions and pointwise nonlinearities, both native to an analog crossbar, reaches an FID of 3.51 when trained by backpropagation.

papers.title_en: Simplifying and Improving On-Policy Distillation for Few-Step Diffusion
papers.authors: Jiawei Zhang, Ziyu Wan, Nanye Ma, Long Zhao, Dong Chen, Hongyu Liu, Qifeng Chen, Dongdong Chen
papers.evidence: 面向少步扩散与流模型的在线速度回归蒸馏
papers.tldr: 少步扩散蒸馏能降低采样成本，但现有方法常依赖辅助评分模型或特殊架构，增加复杂度并限制部署。SMD以简单同策略速度回归为基础，引入训练期Pivot残差代理分离局部校正与学生区间均值，并排斥较弱教师预测以避开不良模态。框架保持纯回归，无需在线评分或对抗训练，且不改变部署生成器；在4-NFE图像生成与编辑、3D、视频及音视频任务上扩展至330亿参数，超越强少步基线，并在多项基准胜过教师。
papers.abstract_en: Few-step distillation reduces the sampling cost of diffusion and flow models, but existing approaches often require auxiliary score models or specialized architectures. We show that simple on-policy velocity regression already provides a strong foundation for 4-NFE generation. To represent teacher velocity variation within each coarse transition, we introduce Pivot, a training-only residual proxy that separates local corrections from the student's interval-mean prediction. We further repel the student from weaker teacher predictions, providing a lightweight mechanism for avoiding undesirable modes. The resulting framework, Simplified Matching Distillation (SMD), remains entirely regression-based, requires neither online score estimation nor adversarial training, and leaves the deployed generator unchanged. We evaluate SMD on image generation and editing, 3D generation, video synthesis, and joint audio--video generation, scaling to 33 billion parameters. At 4-NFE, SMD outperforms strong few-step baselines and surpasses multi-step teachers on several benchmarks. It also supports cross-model, multi-teacher, and causal-video distillation.

papers.title_en: Annealed Lévy Diffusion via Gaussian Surrogate Reverse Dynamics
papers.authors: Yuling Jiao, Lican Kang, Jerry Zhijian Yang, Cheng Yuan, Ruizhe Zhang
papers.evidence: 结合重尾扰动与高斯精修的退火扩散生成模型
papers.tldr: 高斯扩散模型实用，但DLPM全程固定尾指数，难以兼顾重尾探索与高斯精修。本文提出退火Lévy扩散ALD，令稳定性指数α(t)随时间变化，并用标量高斯尺度混合表示稳定噪声，从而复用标准噪声预测训练，仅多一个尺度输入。两种采样器ALD-renoise与ALD-posterior共享同一预测器。二维基准、九模态不平衡混合及MNIST/CelebA64/CIFAR-10LT实验显示，ALD在轻尾和流形结构目标上保持局部几何。
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian diffusion models offer a practical framework for generative modeling. Denoising Lévy Probabilistic Models (DLPM) introduce heavy-tailed perturbations with a fixed tail index throughout denoising. We introduce Annealed Lévy Diffusion (ALD). ALD varies the stability index $α(t)$ to combine heavy-tailed exploration with Gaussian refinement. Our marginal-first formulation represents stable noise as a scalar Gaussian scale mixture. This formulation enables standard Gaussian noise-prediction training with one additional scale input. We study two sampling processes. ALD-renoise estimates the clean sample and injects fresh marginal noise. ALD-posterior preserves dependence between successive states through an accumulated conditional variance and a Gaussian bridge update. Both samplers reuse the same trained predictor with different scalar inputs. We evaluate ALD on four 2D benchmarks and an imbalanced nine-mode mixture. We also examine training efficiency and the effects of prediction perturbations on clipped Holtsmark data. Additional experiments evaluate MNIST and CelebA64 generation and CIFAR-10LT augmentation. ALD preserves local geometry on the evaluated light-tailed and manifold-structured targets.

papers.title_en: Two-Stage Score Estimation for Group-Specific Diffusion Models
papers.authors: Huitao Yang, Oscar Hernan Madrid Padilla
papers.evidence: 面向群体特定扩散模型的扩散迁移与分数估计统计框架
papers.tldr: 针对目标分布观测有限、但存在相关分布共享结构的生成问题，本文提出两阶段score估计的扩散迁移统计框架。方法将共享池化score与目标特定偏移分开学习，并在Besov正则与稳定分层复合假设下推导收敛率。结果显示该分解能区分两部分学习代价，并刻画简化偏移优于单独拟合的条件；偏移在扩散时间趋零时保持有界且联合正则。由此允许下截断时间多项式消失，并给出扩散模型作为密度估计器的全变差保证。
papers.abstract_en: Generative modeling across related distributions raises a question: how can shared structure support accurate generation for a target distribution with limited observations? We develop a statistical framework for diffusion transfer that analyzes a shared pooled score together with a target-specific offset. Under Besov regularity of the pooled density and a stable hierarchical composition model for the offset, we derive convergence rates that separate the costs of learning these components and identify when a simpler offset yields a faster risk-bound rate than separate fitting. Under suitable boundary and regularity assumptions, we prove that the offset remains bounded and jointly regular as diffusion time approaches zero. These results allow the lower time cutoff to vanish polynomially and provide total-variation guarantees for diffusion models as density estimators. Synthetic simulations and image benchmarks provide a proof of concept for the framework.

papers.title_en: KODA: Kinematics--Observation Data Alignment for Humanoid Learning from Human Egocentric Demonstration
papers.authors: Zibo Zhou, Yueru Chen, Junsong Wu, Weiji Xie, Qingyao Xu, Sheng Yin, Shiqing Wang, Jiyuan Shi, Siheng Chen, Chenjia Bai, Xuelong Li
papers.evidence: 将人类第一视角演示转换为全身动作数据
papers.tldr: 人形全身VLA策略依赖昂贵的机器人示教，而第一视角人类演示存在视角错位和动作稀疏问题。KODA将第一视角RGB演示转换为可复用的规范化全身轨迹，并用其合成机器人视角观测、生成控制器相关状态动作监督。在Unitree G1四项移动操作任务和两种控制器上，人类演示覆盖但机器人数据缺失条件下的宏平均成功率提升45.0与46.25个百分点。该方法降低了跨控制器复用人类数据训练人形VLA的门槛。
papers.abstract_en: Training humanoid whole-body vision-language-action (VLA) policies requires costly robot demonstrations with aligned robot-view observations and controller-compatible whole-body state-action labels. Egocentric human demonstrations offer scalable supervision but have misaligned views and sparse motion cues. Existing approaches either pretrain policies that still require robot data for adaptation or generate controller-specific commands that limit reuse. Conversion also requires robot-view observations aligned with the generated whole-body motion. We present KODA (Kinematics-Observation Data Alignment), which converts egocentric RGB demonstrations into whole-body VLA training data using a reusable canonical trajectory to guide robot-view synthesis and generate controller-specific whole-body state-action supervision. KODA first generates a simulator-checked whole-body trajectory using a sparse tracker with sampling-based command optimization. This generated trajectory directly determines the onboard camera poses used to synthesize corresponding robot-view observations. The motion, observations, and task instruction form a canonical record. For each deployment controller, KODA optimizes commands to track the stored motion and records the corresponding action labels and proprioceptive states. When switching controllers, KODA retains this canonical record and regenerates whole-body state-action supervision for co-training with matching robot demonstrations. We evaluate KODA on four Unitree G1 loco-manipulation tasks using two whole-body controllers, SONIC and HEFT. With robot data held fixed, macro-average success on conditions covered by human demonstrations but absent from robot data improves by 45.0 and 46.25 percentage points, respectively. Under both controllers, this metric shows an upward trend across the evaluated human-data budgets, suggesting potential for further scaling.

papers.title_en: Rethinking Classifier-Free Guidance for TI2I Flow Matching
papers.authors: Andreas Floros, Elena Koritska, Teofilo de Campos, Christoph Vogel, Chu-Tak Li, Anuj Sharma, Alexandros Neophytou
papers.evidence: 面向文本图像到图像流匹配的无分类器引导修正
papers.tldr: 在面向可控图像编辑的TI2I流匹配中，CFG虽被视为生成质量关键，但其在编辑任务中的作用仍缺乏清晰理解。作者意外发现，CFG在流建模的早期噪声阶段会隐性损害编辑效果，削弱指令跟随与可控性。为此，他们仅在前几步流中施加简单校正，在不增加额外成本的前提下获得更丰富的对齐与保持权衡。实验在像素空间和潜空间TI2I流上均验证了有效性。
papers.abstract_en: We study Text-and-Image-to-Image (TI2I) flow matching methods for controllable image editing. In a broader generative modeling context, Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) is established as a key component responsible for high quality outputs. However, we argue that its role in TI2I modeling is poorly understood. Specifically, we make the surprising observation that the CFG mechanism is implicitly harmful for editing in the noisy phase of flow modeling, hindering instruction following and controllability. We propose a simple correction in the early flow steps, enabling a richer alignment-preservation tradeoff at no extra cost. The effectiveness of our approach is demonstrated on both pixel-space and latent TI2I flows.

papers.title_en: Conditional Mean Flows: Few-Step Densities for Simulation-Based Inference
papers.authors: Jonas Arruda, Jan Hasenauer, Stefan T. Radev
papers.evidence: 基于流匹配的条件均值流实现少步采样与密度评估
papers.tldr: 基于流的仿真推断在推理时依赖数值积分，后验采样和MCMC中的重复密度评估代价高昂。作者提出条件均值流，联合进行后验与似然近似，以少步采样获得可处理密度，并利用独立掩码直接估计边际似然。实验显示单步条件均值流密度评估误差可与200步流匹配相当，下游MCMC约加速200倍。该方法保留流模型灵活性，同时显著降低推断成本。
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching has emerged as a powerful generative family for simulation-based inference (SBI). However, sampling and density evaluation require numerical integration at inference time. This makes posterior sampling in neural posterior estimation costly. More importantly, it can make repeated likelihood evaluation prohibitively expensive and impractical for Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling, which may require thousands of repeated density evaluations. Here, we develop conditional mean flows for posterior and likelihood approximation, combining few-step sampling with tractable density evaluation. We show that the mean flow objective identifies conditional flow maps and that independent masking enables direct estimation of marginal likelihoods. We evaluate both posterior and likelihood estimation across several tasks and show that conditional mean flows retain the flexibility of flow-based density estimators while significantly reducing inference time. In particular, single-step conditional mean flow density evaluation yields estimation error comparable to 200-step flow matching while enabling about 200-fold faster downstream MCMC sampling.
